title: Customer Complaints
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo manejar quejas de clientes de manera profesional y resolutiva.

parts.visual:
Recibiendo la queja: 
- Complain (Quejarse) / Complaint (Queja). 
- Apologize (Disculparse). 
- Look into (Investigar). 
Ej: We apologize for the inconvenience. We will look into the matter immediately.
parts.audio: Receiving the complaint. Complain is the verb, complaint is the noun. Apologize means to say sorry. Look into means to investigate. For example: We apologize for the inconvenience. We will look into the matter immediately.

parts.visual:
Resolviendo el problema: 
- Refund (Reembolso). 
- Replace (Reemplazar). 
- Solve / Resolve (Resolver). 
Ej: We can offer you a full refund or replace the damaged item.
parts.audio: Solving the problem. Refund means to give money back. Replace means to give a new item instead of the old one. Solve or Resolve. For example: We can offer you a full refund or replace the damaged item.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para manejar problemas y quejas.

questions.question: We received a formal ____ from a client yesterday. (Queja - sustantivo).
questions.explanation: Complaint (con 't' al final) es el sustantivo (la queja). Complain es el verbo (quejarse).

questions.question: Many customers ____ about the slow service. (Se quejaron - verbo).
We sincerely ____ for the delay. (Nos disculpamos).
questions.explanation: Apologize = disculparse (forma profesional de decir 'we are sorry').

questions.question: I am writing to express my ____ with the product. (Insatisfacción).
Let me ____ into this matter right away. (Investigar / Revisar).
questions.explanation: Look into (a matter/an issue) = investigar, revisar un asunto.

questions.question: We can offer you a full ____ of your money. (Reembolso).
The item arrived broken, so we will ____ it for free. (Reemplazar).
We promise to ____ the issue within 24 hours. (Resolver).
I demand to speak to the ____! (Gerente).
We are sorry for the ____ this has caused you. (Inconveniencia / Molestia).
questions.explanation: Inconvenience = inconveniencia/molestia (muy usado en atención al cliente).

questions.question: As a gesture of ____, here is a 20% discount coupon. (Buena voluntad).
questions.explanation: A gesture of goodwill = un gesto de buena voluntad (para compensar un error).

questions.question: Your ____ is very important to us. (Opinión/Retroalimentación).
We will ____ the product if it is defective. (Reparar).
This product does not meet our quality ____. (Estándares).
The package was ____ during shipping. (Dañado).
Please ____ the defective item in its original box. (Devolver).
It was our ____. We sent the wrong size. (Error / Culpa).
questions.explanation: It was our fault = Fue nuestra culpa.

questions.question: We will ____ this problem from happening again. (Prevenir / Evitar).
Thank you for bringing this to our ____. (Atención).
questions.explanation: Thank you for bringing this to our attention = Gracias por informarnos de esto (traerlo a nuestra atención).

questions.question: I would like to ____ an order. It hasn't arrived yet. (Cancelar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta de atención al cliente.

questions.question: A customer ____. (Queja - sustantivo con T al final)
We sincerely ____. (Nos disculpamos)
We will offer a ____. (Reembolso)
We will ____ the item. (Reemplazar)
We will ____ the issue. (Resolver con R)
Sorry for the ____. (Inconveniencia)
I want to speak to the ____. (Gerente)
It was our ____. (Culpa)
Please ____ the item. (Devolver)
The package was ____. (Dañado)
